::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
## About the Technical Report
Your final technical report documents the complete journey from system modeling to control implementation. Use this page as a checklist to ensure your report is thorough and well-structured.
:::

## 1 Model the System

- Develop a mathematical model of the reaction wheel system using angular momentum conservation principles.
- Derive the equations of motion and obtain a transfer function representing the system dynamics.
- Estimate the model parameters of your implemented system. (Assume any missing parameters.)

## 2 Control Design

- Use the transfer function to design a control system that stabilizes the platform.
- Design and analyze multiple feedback control strategies (test **at least four controllers**) to achieve the desired control objectives.
- Choose control parameters that ensure system stability, fast response, and minimal overshoot.

## 3 Simulate the System

- Implement the system model and control design in MATLAB/Simulink.
- Simulate different scenarios to analyze system behavior, including external disturbances and initial condition variations.
- Use time-domain and frequency-domain techniques to evaluate the system's performance metrics, including stability, rise time, settling time, and steady-state error.

## 4 Project Report

- Write a report detailing the system model, control design, simulation results, and implementation insights.
- Include references and resources used.

## Assessment Criteria

Your technical report will be graded on:

1. Accuracy and clarity of system modeling and derivation of equations.
2. Effectiveness of the control design in achieving stability and performance goals.
3. Completeness and accuracy of simulations, including performance metrics and stability analysis.
4. Quality and thoroughness of the report.
5. Peer evaluation.
